Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the partner organization was "Google" based on a misinterpretation of the Wikipedia snippet. The snippet explicitly stated that YouTube Rewind was "produced by YouTube and Portal A Interactive from 2010 to 2019." While Google owns YouTube, the specific production credit for the annual production (YouTube Rewind) lists Portal A Interactive as the co-producer, not Google directly. The Planner ignored the explicit mention of "Portal A Interactive" in favor of the parent company (Google), leading to an inaccurate answer. This error occurred in Step 4 when the Planner made the final decision to mark the task as complete with the wrong entity.
